about.title: Unparalleled security across the Kurdistan Region.

body.p1: At Harekar Group, we provide unparalleled security solutions throughout the Kurdistan Region of Iraq (KRI). Our extensive expertise covers a comprehensive range of security domains, including static security, mobile security, K9 units, armored vehicles and more. We are relentlessly dedicated to ensuring the absolute safety and security of our clients through cutting-edge, dependable solutions.
body.p2: Our security services are backed by rigorous training, advanced technology and a proactive approach to threat management. We anticipate risks before they become threats, ensuring our clients can operate with complete peace of mind.
body.p3: In addition to our security services, we excel in civil works, offering specialized knowledge in construction and infrastructure development. Our projects are characterized by quality and adherence to the highest standards, ensuring successful outcomes.

mission.title: Mission
mission.body: Our mission is to safeguard lives, assets and infrastructure with unwavering dedication and accountability. We view security challenges as opportunities for innovation and advancement, setting new standards in industry. By consistently delivering value and quality, we aim to become a symbol of reliability and excellence in security services, civil work, fuel transport and other scopes of work.

vision.title: Vision
vision.body: At Harekar Group, our vision is to lead the security industry with integrity and innovative methods. We envision a future where advanced technology and human expertise blend seamlessly to provide top-notch security solutions. Our goal is to be recognized for our excellence in security, construction and fuel logistics, ensuring the safety and success of our clients.

types.q: What types of security services do you offer?
types.a: We offer a comprehensive range of security services, including:
list: Fuel and Water Supply and Transport

hours.a: Yes, we do provide 24/7 security services with fully in-house facilities and equipment.

response.q: What are your emergency response times?
response.a: We have offices in Erbil, Duhok and Sulaymaniyah, which allows us to be very responsive. For other cities our Quick Reaction Force (QRF) team is always on standby.

licensed.q: Are your guards licensed and trained?
licensed.a: Yes, our guards are licensed and trained according to international standards by accredited trainers.

vetting.q: What is the process for hiring and vetting your security personnel?
vetting.a: Personnel are being assessed on all personal and functional aspects and then accepted ones will be forwarded to training departments so as to be readily deployed to their task.

specialized.q: Can I request specialized security personnel for my needs?
specialized.a: Yes, certainly, we do provide specialized security personnel that suits our clients' needs.
